appearance: Guide surfaces, borders, radii, font weights and shadows now use Espresso/Bazaar theme tokens instead of an independent blue-black gradient palette. Existing page grids, widths, section order, image aspect ratios/positions and breakpoints remain. Hover lift and glow effects are flattened.

fieldFocus.humanRequest: Remove unattractive native/duplicate field outlines or restyle them consistently.
fieldFocus.reproduced: Guide search drew a 2px ring on the raw input plus another 2px ring on its container. Ordinary fields also drew a surrounding Tailwind ring. Evidence: artifacts/ux/espresso/input-focus-before.json and screenshots/input-help-focus-before.png.
fieldFocus.change: Text-like native inputs, textarea, native select and shared select triggers now have outline:none, box-shadow:none and one blue focus border. Composite Guide search and Baam editor put that border on their existing outer container, with no inner border/ring. aria-invalid=true retains the red border. Shared field dimensions, values, events, refs, masks, validation and disabled behavior are unchanged.
fieldFocus.observed: Actual text, keyboard Tab, custom select, native mobile select, email, phone, empty password and reveal toggle, number, textarea, product search, invalid profile field and Baam composer. Selected desktop/mobile light/dark states all have outlineStyle none and boxShadow none. Error is a 1px red border; ordinary/composite focus is a 1px blue border. The Baam inner textarea stays borderless.
fieldFocus.limits: Codex in-app browser on macOS; no browser engine, every-browser, physical mobile keyboard or OS picker claim. Checkbox/radio/range/color/file/button controls retain their own control styling; this is a targeted field rule, not a global removal of keyboard focus.

explicitBehaviorChanges: Help search Escape clears even a zero-result query; popup ARIA references exist only when their targets exist. Advertised Ctrl/Command K now focuses the search. Role tabs support arrows/Home/End with a single tab stop and linked active panel.

Getting-started progress survives normal reload and stays usable for the current visit if browser storage rejects writes/removal. The language switcher shows a translated failure and permits retry after HTTP/network failure instead of leaving an unhandled rejection.

Employee task now opens settings/add-employee; first store setup step opens getting-started/choose-store. Those two links were swapped in the original catalog. No instruction body, workflow permission or operational action was rewritten.

All twelve advertised quick searches are tested. Receiving gains the missing Russian noun alias; normalization now retains Unicode letters/numbers, including Kyrgyz characters, instead of deleting them. Ranking/scoring remains unchanged.
Guide HowTo structured data uses the displayed locale rather than always Russian. Canonical routes and article sourceRoute transport remain; legacy redirect policy is unchanged.
